properties.name: Corollary and proposition are statement kinds
properties.rationale: Anthony chose it on 2026-10-17: "Add corollary and proposition". The reading code already fell through to `stated` for any kind that is not a definition, axiom or conjecture, so the change is the enum and the text that lists the kinds; taken-as-given stays definition and axiom only. A core test sets each new kind and reads its statement_reading (fails on main), and the wire test records both over the tools. PR branch feat/corollary-and-proposition. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: `statement_kind` on Requirement and Constraint gains `corollary` and `proposition`: the kinds are now theorem, lemma, corollary, proposition, definition, axiom and conjecture. A corollary and a proposition read like a theorem or lemma, `stated` until a step concludes them, then the conclusion's proof status; neither is taken as given. Schema enum, STATEMENT_KINDS, the add_requirement / add_constraint descriptions and toolsnaps, the design-a-proof skill and command, and #764's changelog fragment (same unreleased 0.86.0).
